race.description: Purcell Civil And Construction Plough Inn Cup Mdn Plate
race.comment: SOLO HUNTER (4) produced a nice effort on debut in better company last start over 1350m at Ipswich when third, beaten only half a length. Aided by the rails draw so he will be hard to beat. QUEEN VICTORIOUS (8) is back after a break of ten weeks. At the last run before the layoff she finished tenth over 1600m at Pakenham Synthetic. Will find this easier than what she faced down south. Hard to beat if back in good order as anticipated. LAW AND ORDER (1) is a five-start maiden who finished eighth at his most recent appearance over 1350m at Doomben after he was well back on straightening. Worth including in this more suitable contest. MOONLIGHT ODYSSEY (2) finished third last time over 1200m at Kilcoy when resuming from a spell, beaten 4 lengths. Will trim down second-up. In the right race and is one of the better hopes.
